predictions.before_fix: When the first mover uses Double Kick and the second mover has pending Flail or Reversal, the exact-roll fan-out calls run_move with hit_count=1 and emits only one defender Damage instruction.
predictions.after_fix: The exact-roll fan-out preserves the move's ordinary hit count. Double Kick emits two defender Damage instructions in every damaging branch; the ordinary no-Flail control remains unchanged.
predictions.boundary: This preserves the engine's existing correlated/average multi-hit approximation; it does not claim independent random rolls for every hit of two-to-five-hit moves.

predictions.before_fix: A secondary-bearing attack passes the pre-cap damage roll into deferred Color Change. Ice Beam into a 1-HP Kecleon protected by Endure can emit Damage 0 followed by NORMAL->ICE.
predictions.after_fix: Deferred Color Change receives the actual direct damage dealt to the target. A zero-damage Endure branch never changes type, while positive-damage Ice Beam keeps freeze-before-Color-Change ordering.
predictions.showdown_basis: Gen 3 inherits Color Change's onDamagingHit guard `if (!damage || !target.hp) return`; the callback receives actual damage.

required_controls: A first mover without a pending Flail/Reversal defender keeps the ordinary multi-hit path.
Positive direct damage still triggers Color Change after move secondaries.
Substitute hits do not trigger Color Change.
